verses.en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
verses.pt: O meu espírito está quebrantado, os meus dias se extinguem, a sepultura me está preparada!
verses.en_web: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, And the grave is ready for me.
verses.en_bbe: My spirit is broken, my days are ended, the last resting-place is ready for me.

verses.en: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
verses.pt: Deveras estou cercado de zombadores, e os meus olhos contemplam a sua provocação!
verses.en_web: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, those who make sport of me are round about me, and my eyes become dark because of their bitter laughing.

verses.en: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
verses.pt: Dá-me, peço-te, um penhor, e sê o meu fiador para contigo; quem mais há que me dê a mão?
verses.en_web: “Now give a pledge, be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
verses.en_bbe: Be pleased, now, to be responsible for me to yourself; for there is no other who will put his hand in mine.

verses.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
verses.pt: Porque aos seus corações encobriste o entendimento, pelo que não os exaltarás.
verses.en_web: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you shall not exalt them.
verses.en_bbe: You have kept their hearts from wisdom: for this cause you will not give them honour.

verses.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.pt: Quem entrega os seus amigos como presa, os olhos de seus filhos desfalecerão.
verses.en_web: He who denounces his friends for plunder, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.en_bbe: As for him who is false to his friend for a reward, light will be cut off from the eyes of his children.

verses.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.pt: Mas a mim me pôs por motejo dos povos; tornei-me como aquele em cujo rosto se cospe.
verses.en_web: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
verses.en_bbe: He has made me a word of shame to the peoples; I have become a mark for their sport.

verses.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
verses.pt: De mágoa se escureceram os meus olhos, e todos os meus membros são como a sombra.
verses.en_web: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
verses.en_bbe: My eyes have become dark because of my pain, and all my body is wasted to a shade.

verses.en: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.pt: Os retos pasmam disso, e o inocente se levanta contra o ímpio.
verses.en_web: Upright men shall be astonished at this. The innocent shall stir up himself against the godless.
verses.en_bbe: The upright are surprised at this, and he who has done no wrong is troubled because of the evil-doers.

verses.en: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.pt: Contudo o justo prossegue no seu caminho e o que tem mãos puras vai crescendo em força.
verses.en_web: Yet shall the righteous hold on his way. He who has clean hands shall grow stronger and stronger.
verses.en_bbe: Still the upright keeps on his way, and he who has clean hands gets new strength.

verses.en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
verses.pt: Mas tornai vós todos, e vinde, e sábio nenhum acharei entre vós.
verses.en_web: But as for you all, come on now again; I shall not find a wise man among you.
verses.en_bbe: But come back, now, all of you, come; and I will not see a wise man among you.

verses.en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.pt: Os meus dias passaram, malograram-se os meus propósitos, as aspirações do meu coração.
verses.en_web: My days are past, my plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
verses.en_bbe: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the desires of my heart.

verses.en: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
verses.pt: Trocam a noite em dia; dizem que a luz está perto das trevas. el,
verses.en_web: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
verses.en_bbe: They are changing night into day; they say, The light is near the dark.

verses.en: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.pt: Se eu olhar o Seol como a minha casa, se nas trevas estender a minha cama,
verses.en_web: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
verses.en_bbe: If I am waiting for the underworld as my house, if I have made my bed in the dark;

verses.en: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
verses.pt: se eu clamar à cova: Tu és meu pai; e aos vermes: Vós sois minha mãe e minha irmã;
verses.en_web: If I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’ to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘my sister;’
verses.en_bbe: If I say to the earth, You are my father; and to the worm, My mother and my sister;

verses.en: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.pt: onde está então a minha esperança? Sim, a minha esperança, quem a poderá ver?
verses.en_web: where then is my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.en_bbe: Where then is my hope? and who will see my desire?

verses.en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
verses.pt: Acaso descerá comigo até os ferrolhos do Seol? Descansaremos juntos no pó?
verses.en_web: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
verses.en_bbe: Will they go down with me into the underworld? Will we go down together into the dust?
